_source.current_66: CIPAC Handbook, Appendix D (Codes for Formulations), citing CropLife International Technical Monograph N2, 8th Edition, Revised March 2023
_source.discontinued_30: CropLife International Technical Monograph N2, 8th Edition (2022-11-08/09 CLI-SEG revision), section 'Formulation codes which are no longer supported for new developments'
_source.note: current + discontinued = 96 total codes. Discontinued codes remain valid on existing/legacy labels but must not be used for new product development/registration. term_ko is a working Korean gloss (mirrors established Korean pesticide-formulation usage where known; otherwise a literal translation) - not an official RDA publication, verify before using in regulatory filings.

current.definition: A container-held formulation which is dispersed generally by a propellant as fine droplets or particles upon the actuation of a valve.
A liquid not yet designated by a specific code, to be applied undiluted.
A powder not yet designated by a specific code, to be applied undiluted.
Solid block designed for controlled release of active ingredient into water.
A solid or liquid intended for dilution before use as a bait.
Rodenticidal or insecticidal formulation in powder form for direct application. Formerly known as tracking powder (TP).
A stable suspension of capsules in a fluid, normally intended for dilution with water before use.
A liquid homogeneous formulation to be applied as a solid dispersion after dilution in water. (Some formulations are intermediate between DC and EC.)
A free-flowing powder suitable for dusting.
A powder for application in the dry state directly to the seed.
Tablets applied individually and directly in the field/water bodies, without preparing a spraying solution or dispersion.
A liquid, homogeneous formulation to be applied as an emulsion after dilution in water.
A granular formulation, which may contain water-insoluble formulants, applied as an oil-in-water emulsion after disintegration in water.
A fluid, heterogeneous formulation: a solution of pesticide in water dispersed as fine globules in a continuous organic liquid phase.
A powder formulation, which may contain water-insoluble formulants, applied as an oil-in-water emulsion after dispersion in water.
A stable emulsion for application to the seed either directly or after dilution.
A fluid, heterogeneous formulation: a solution of pesticide in an organic liquid dispersed as fine globules in a continuous water phase.
A stable SUSPENSION for application to the seed, either directly or after dilution. (Undissolved solids - contrast with LS.)
A combustible formulation, generally solid, which upon ignition releases the active ingredient(s) as smoke.
A gas packed in pressure bottle or pressure tank.
A gel-like preparation to be applied undiluted.
A formulation which generates a gas by chemical reaction.
A gelatinized formulation to be applied as an emulsion in water.
A free-flowing solid formulation of a defined granule size range, ready for use.
Very viscous formulation based on oil or fat.
A gelatinized formulation to be applied as an aqueous solution.
A formulation suitable for application by hot fogging equipment, either directly or after dilution.
A solid and a liquid formulation, separately packed in one outer pack, for simultaneous tank-mix application. (Twin-pack special code.)
Two liquid formulations, separately packed in one outer pack, for simultaneous tank-mix application. (Twin-pack special code.)
A formulation suitable for application by cold fogging equipment, either directly or after dilution.
A slow/controlled-release treated storage bag providing physical and chemical barriers to pests.
A slow/controlled-release netting formulation providing physical/chemical barriers to insects (bulk netting or ready-to-use, e.g. mosquito nets).
A clear to opalescent liquid applied to the seed, directly or as a solution after dilution. TRUE SOLUTION - contrast with FS (suspension).
A coil which smoulders without flame, releasing the active ingredient as vapour/smoke.
A clear to opalescent, oil-and-water-containing liquid, applied directly or after dilution in water.
A slow/controlled-release polymer-matrix formulation providing long-lasting effects, applied directly.
A stable suspension of active ingredient(s) in a water-immiscible fluid, which may contain other dissolved active(s), for dilution with water before use.

current.term_en: Oil miscible flowable concentrate (oil miscible suspension)
current.definition: A stable suspension of active ingredient(s) in a fluid intended for dilution in an organic liquid before use.
A liquid, homogeneous formulation applied as a homogeneous liquid after dilution in an organic liquid.
A powder formulation to be applied as a suspension after dispersion in an organic liquid.
Water-based, film-forming composition.
A small rodlet (a few cm long, a few mm diameter) containing an active ingredient.
A formulation designed to attract and be eaten by the target pests. (Covers solid, liquid, or gel bait sub-forms - no separate CIPAC code for 'gel bait'.)
A stable suspension of active ingredient(s) with water as the fluid, for dilution with water before use. NOTE: 'flowable concentrate' (non-seed-treatment) = SC, not to be confused with FS.
A stable suspension for direct application (e.g. to rice paddies), may contain other dissolved active(s).
A fluid, heterogeneous formulation: stable dispersion of solid particles AND water-immiscible fine globules in a continuous water phase.
Granules applied as a true solution after dissolution in water; may contain insoluble inert ingredients.
A clear to opalescent liquid applied as a solution of the active ingredient after dilution in water. TRUE SOLUTION intended for dilution (contrast AL = undiluted; TD = trigger-spray RTU).
Formulation designed to form a surface layer on application to water.
A powder formulation applied as a true solution after dissolution in water; may contain insoluble inert ingredients.
Tablets forming a solution of the active ingredient after disintegration in water; may contain water-insoluble formulants.
A suspension ready for use through ULV equipment.
Pre-formed solids of uniform shape/dimensions, usually circular with flat or convex faces.
A material resulting from a manufacturing process comprising the active ingredient plus associated impurities; may contain small amounts of necessary additives. (No diluent.)
A container-held, propellant-free liquid formulation, ready to use, dispersed as droplets by actuation of a trigger.
A material resulting from a manufacturing process comprising the active ingredient plus associated impurities; may contain small amounts of necessary additives AND appropriate diluents.
A homogeneous liquid ready for use through ULV equipment.
A formulation containing volatile active ingredient(s) whose vapours are released into the air, evaporation rate controlled by formulation/dispenser.
Granules applied after disintegration and dispersion in water.
A powder formulation applied as a suspension after dispersion in water.

current.term_en: Water dispersible powder for slurry seed treatment
current.definition: A powder dispersed at high concentration in water before application as a slurry to the seed.
Tablets forming a dispersion of the active ingredient after disintegration in water.
Temporary categorization of all other formulations not listed above.

current.term_en: A mixed formulation of CS and SC
current.definition: A stable suspension of capsules and active ingredient(s) in fluid, for dilution with water before use.

current.term_en: A mixed formulation of CS and SE
current.definition: Stable dispersion of capsules, solid particles, and fine globules in a continuous water phase, for dilution with water before use.

current.term_en: A mixed formulation of CS and EW
current.definition: Stable dispersion of capsules and fine globules in a continuous water phase, for dilution with water before use.

discontinued.definition: Special form of bait.
Special form of bait.
A stable suspension of capsules in a fluid, applied to seed directly or after dilution.
A granule with a protective/release-controlling coating.
Rodenticidal/insecticidal liquid or gel for direct application (or after dilution for gels).
Special liquid formulation for electrostatic (electrodynamic) spraying.
Special form of smoke generator.
A granule in the particle size range 300-2500 μm.
Special form of smoke generator.
Special form of smoke generator.
Special form of smoke generator.
Special form of smoke generator.
Special form of smoke generator.
Special form of bait.
A homogeneous gelatinous formulation applied directly to the seed.
A granule in the particle size range 2000-6000 μm.
Very fine dustable powder for pneumatic application in greenhouses.
Two solid formulations, separately packed in one outer pack, for simultaneous tank-mix application.
Solvent-based, film-forming composition.
A liquid formulation in a cartridge/bottle fitted to a heater unit; passes up a heated wick and evaporates.
A granule in the particle size range 100-600 μm.
A pulp/inert mat impregnated with active ingredient, used in a heater unit for slow volatilisation.
Special form of bait.
A solid formulation applied as a gel or paste after dilution with water.
Solution for pouring on the skin of animals in a high volume (normally more than 100 ml per animal).
Application form. NOT considered a formulation type.
Solution for spot application on the skin of animals in a low volume (normally less than 100 ml per animal).
Special form of bait.

discontinued.term_en: Water soluble powder for seed treatment
discontinued.definition: A powder to be dissolved in water before application to the seed.
Discontinued term. Refer to CP.

SB.usage: Append to code if packaged in a sealed water-soluble bag, e.g. WP-SB.
